assertions.source: (S01+S10)/S00 spread 2.522 > 1e-8 across q in [0.10, 0.40] — not constant

description: Bean qou-l15q: tests whether the 4_1 Stokes structure constant (S12 + S21 = 3*S11, exact q-series identity certified in #4447) generalizes to rank 3 via 5_2. It does NOT: the direct transcription (S01+S10)/S00 varies with q, so GGM eq-65 is rank-2-specific and no rank-3 symmetry constant exists. det S+ = 1 does generalize (control). Consequence: the q-independence of A_omega = 3 is a rank-2 property, not a general law — a scope limitation on #4447. Under the one rank-general reading (classical q->0 (sigma1,sigma2) entry: 3 for 4_1, 4 for 5_2) both 'why 3' candidates are refuted (|disc| predicts 23, |Alexander middle coeff| predicts 3, entry is 4) — conditional on that reading, which is natural but not derived. Uses the corpus's own certified 5_2 assembly; adds no new Stokes construction. No fit; nothing wired.

data.verdict: THE 4₁ STRUCTURE CONSTANT DOES NOT GENERALIZE TO RANK 3. For 5₂ the direct transcription (S₀₁+S₁₀)/S₀₀ varies across q (spread 2.522 over q ∈ [0.10, 0.40]) — it is not a constant, so GGM's eq-65 symmetry is genuinely rank-2-specific and there is no rank-3 'symmetry constant'. det S⁺ = 1 DOES generalize (control passed). CONSEQUENCE FOR #4447: the q-independence that made A_ω = 3 an exact structure constant is a rank-2 property, NOT a general feature — that result stands for 4₁ but must not be read as a general law. Under the one rank-general reading (the classical q→0 (σ₁,σ₂) entry: 3 for 4₁, 4 for 5₂), BOTH 'why 3' candidates are REFUTED — |disc| predicts 23, |Alexander mid coeff| predicts 3, and the entry is 4. Scope: that reading is the natural one but is a reading, not a derivation; the refutation is conditional on it. Method note: at q=0.25 the ratio is 4.08, so a single-point test would have falsely read as a constant-4 hit. No fit; nothing wired.
